# dify_mcp_provider (Resource)

Manages an MCP provider — a remote MCP server the workspace calls tools from. `server_url` and `headers` are write-only: describe returns them masked, so state keeps the configured values. Import by id: `terraform import dify_mcp_provider.x <id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register an MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool provider.
resource "dify_mcp_provider" "deepwiki" {
  name              = "deepwiki"
  server_url        = "https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"
  server_identifier = "deepwiki"
  icon              = "🌐"
  icon_type         = "emoji"

  headers = {
    Authorization = "Bearer ${var.mcp_token}"
  }
}

variable "mcp_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `icon` (String) Provider icon (emoji character when `icon_type` is `emoji`).
- `name` (String) Provider name.
- `server_identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the server within the workspace.
- `server_url` (String, Sensitive) MCP server URL. Write-only and sensitive; the API returns it masked.

### Optional

- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra HTTP headers sent to the server. Write-only and sensitive.
- `icon_background` (String) Icon background color.
- `icon_type` (String) Icon type (`emoji`, `link`, `image`).
- `sse_read_timeout` (Number) SSE read timeout in seconds (sent as `configuration.sse_read_timeout`).
- `timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds (sent as `configuration.timeout`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID (assigned by Dify).
- `tools` (List of String) Names of the tools the server advertised.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# MCP providers are imported by provider ID.
terraform import dify_mcp_provider.example <provider_id>
```
